data.question: What federal political contributions and past employers can be verified for Brett Leatherman?
data.method: Official FEC Schedule A exact-name, employer and career-location searches combined with first-person interview and public biography review.
findings: Official OpenFEC searches returned zero itemized records for the exact-name forms Brett Leatherman and Leatherman, Brett.
Additional surname checks constrained by FBI employment and known career cities produced no Brett match.
Leatherman entered the FBI in 2003 and public biographies identify FBI assignments in Cleveland, Detroit, Cyber Division and Dallas.
Leatherman stated in a 2024 interview that he worked in the cyber discipline before joining the FBI.
No reliable public source reviewed identifies the pre-FBI employer or company.
Public biographies identify a concurrent adjunct-professor role at Georgetown University while he remained employed by the FBI.
conclusions: Do not assign any federal campaign contribution to Leatherman on the current evidence.
Record pre-FBI cyber employment as confirmed but employer-unresolved.
The only named organizations in his verified employment history are the FBI and Georgetown University.
Continue searching alumni records, archived resumes and pre-2003 technical publications for the unnamed employer.
counterarguments: A contribution could be filed under a middle name, variant spelling, different location or non-itemized aggregate.
The pre-FBI work may have been self-employment, contract work, university work or employment at a company omitted from public biographies.
limitations: No complete pre-2003 resume or personnel file was located.
State and local campaign-finance systems were not included in this federal FEC pass.
FEC negative findings cannot identify unitemized donors.
unresolved: Identify the company or organization where Leatherman performed pre-FBI cyber work.
Search state and local contribution records in Michigan, Ohio, Texas and the District of Columbia.
Search middle-name and initial variants if a reliable full legal name becomes available.

workflow.next_action: Resolve the unnamed pre-FBI cyber employer and expand to state-level campaign-finance records.
